training_data.observation_unit: One customer or case decision point with the state known before an eligible intervention.
training_data.input_data: Consented account, transaction, affordability, channel, prior-contact, case-state, policy and operational-capacity features available at decision time.
training_data.target_or_reward: A bounded outcome such as confirmed fraud prevention, sustainable customer-selected repayment, resolved investigation, or successful low-friction service recovery, penalized for complaints, reversals, harm and regulatory breaches.
training_data.label_source: Audited case outcomes, customer choices, reversals, complaints, confirmed fraud investigations and human review; availability and consistency remain unknown.
training_data.prediction_time: Immediately before selecting among legally and operationally eligible interventions.
training_data.expected_volume: Unknown; must be established per institution and decision type.
training_data.class_balance: Likely sparse positive outcomes and highly uneven action exposure; not confirmed.
training_data.historical_coverage: Existing logs are likely policy-biased and may not record rejected alternatives, propensities or full delayed outcomes.
training_data.train_validation_split: Time-based and policy-version-aware split, with customer/entity isolation and a final prospective shadow evaluation.
training_data.leakage_risks: Post-decision contact results, investigation closure, renegotiation acceptance, later delinquency and manual escalation may leak into features.
training_data.representativeness_risks: Historical policies, channel access, product mix and vulnerable-customer treatment may underrepresent future states and protected groups.
training_data.feedback_loop: Human-approved actions and delayed audited outcomes, with explicit action propensities and complaint/harm monitoring.
training_data.privacy_and_usage_constraints: LGPD purpose limitation, financial secrecy, explainability, automated-decision review rights, credit and consumer-protection controls, and strict prohibition on unconstrained exploration.
training_data.fallback_if_data_is_insufficient: Use deterministic eligibility, policy rules, calibrated supervised risk models, constrained optimization and human review; run only offline or shadow policy evaluation until prospective governance is approved.

simulations: Fraud intervention sequencing after a suspicious Pix or account event.
Selection and timing of customer-approved debt-renegotiation assistance.
Financial-crime investigation action sequencing under analyst capacity constraints.
deterministic_baseline: Regulatory eligibility, risk thresholds, fixed escalation matrices, affordability rules, channel consent, constrained optimization and human authorization.
rejection_reason: The strongest sequential-decision processes overlap existing financial-services opportunities, while safe online exploration is incompatible with current customer, credit, fraud and automated-decision governance. Historical logs also lack proven action propensities and counterfactual coverage for reliable offline policy learning.
